text:
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "正一法文十籙召儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that celestial authority is not abstract belief but operational jurisdiction: only graded 籙 (registers) authorize a priest to summon specific spirit cohorts. Summoning efficacy is therefore a function of transmitted rank plus correct ritual form, not of personal charisma or ad-hoc prayer. Hierarchy of 籙 encodes a map of which powers may be called, under what warrant, and with what liability if misused.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Heaven's bureaucracy is ordered by ranks and warrants, mirrored in transmitted 籙. Inference 1: A name or deity may be invoked only if the officiant's 籙 lists the corresponding spirit office. Inference 2: The ten-register system partitions summoning rights so lower ranks cannot usurp higher commands. Inference 3: Ritual protocol (召儀) is the legal procedure that activates the warrant, not optional theater. Inference 4: Failed summons or spiritual backlash is evidence of rank-protocol mismatch, not mere 'lack of faith.' Conclusion: Legitimate spirit work is licensed administrative action within a transmitted hierarchy.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi/ritual counseling, treat 'which spirits/forces one may petition' as rank-dependent: map client's or practitioner's training level to permitted scopes of 召. 2) Before any exorcistic or petitionary work, verify transmission chain and 籙 grade the way one verifies professional license. 3) Design cultivation stages so each stage unlocks a defined jurisdiction (protective, healing, weather, ancestral), never all at once. 4) Diagnose ritual failure first as warrant mismatch (wrong 籙, wrong day, wrong office), then as technical error. 5) Keep a written inventory of 'authorized actions' analogous to the ten-register roster.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike generic prayer manuals that assume any sincere heart can call any deity, this text insists on jurisdictional warrant. It differs from purely meditative 内丹 texts by treating efficacy as external bureaucratic legitimacy, not only internal qi refinement. Compared with later popular 符法 compilations, it foregrounds graded 籙 as the legal root of 召 rather than the talisman alone as a free-floating tool."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "正一法文傳都功版儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that institutional continuity of Zhengyi authority rests on a single transferable office-token—the 都功版—not on scattered personal sanctity. Transmission of that tablet is a legal investiture: the recipient becomes accountable steward of communal ritual power. Without formal 傳版, claimed leadership is administratively void even if ritually skilled.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Communal Daoist order requires a chief merit/office holder (都功) to coordinate rites and 籙. Inference 1: The 版 is the durable credential that outlasts individual charisma. Inference 2: 傳儀 specifies witnesses, oaths, and materials so succession is public and contestable, not private. Inference 3: Accepting the 版 creates duty (protect community, uphold 盟威, manage 籙), not merely privilege. Inference 4: Illegitimate holders lack the tablet chain and therefore lack standing to ordain or adjudicate. Conclusion: Legitimate Zhengyi headship is proven by continuous, ritualized transmission of the 都功版.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Model lineage succession in modern practice as documented transfer of role + responsibility, not Instagram endorsement. 2) When studying BaZi masters or ritual teachers, ask who invested them and with what token of office. 3) Separate 'skill demonstration' from 'office authority' when evaluating practitioners. 4) In personal cultivation, treat milestones (e.g., first full 籙, first independent jiao) as investitures that add duties. 5) Record transmission dates, witnesses, and scope of authority as a living legal file.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 受籙次第 texts that rank what individuals receive, this focuses on who may govern the system of receiving. It differs from purely hagiographic master-disciple stories by making a material tablet the proof of office. Compared with monastic abbacy models, 都功 is liturgical-legal stewardship of 正一 registers more than property or celibate rule."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "醮三洞真文五法正一盟威籙立成儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that full Zhengyi covenant identity is completed only when Three Caverns true texts, Five Methods, and Mengwei registers are ritually established together in a 醮. Partial exposure to scriptures without 立成 (formal constitution of the 籙) does not create covenantal standing. Integration of canon strata with register investiture is the logical condition of being a '正一盟威' practitioner in the full sense.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Daoist revelation is stratified (三洞) and operationalized through 籙 and methods (五法). Inference 1: Reading 真文 without 立成 leaves the text informational, not binding. Inference 2: 盟威 covenant requires mutual obligation between Heaven and recipient, sealed in 醮. Inference 3: Combining 三洞 + 五法 + 正一籙 prevents sectarian fragmentation of authority. Inference 4: '立成' means the 籙 is constituted as a living warrant in time and place, not merely copied. Conclusion: Complete Zhengyi personhood is a multi-layer ritual constitution, not single-scripture conversion.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Structure training curricula as layered constitution: doctrine (三洞) → methods (五法) → warrants (籙) → public seal (醮). 2) Do not grant clients or students 'full path' claims after one book or one talisman course. 3) Use BaZi timing for 立成 moments (auspicious days for covenant, not only for fortune-telling). 4) Treat ethical vows in the 醮 as binding constraints on later magical practice. 5) Audit whether one's practice is only textual study, only technique, or fully covenanted.",
      "logic_compare": "Broader than single-register manuals (e.g., 延生保命籙 alone), it synthesizes canon and covenant. Unlike pure liturgy of petition without ordination, it insists on 立成 of 籙 as identity formation. Relative to 外籙儀, it aims at fuller multi-stratum constitution rather than outer/introductory enrollment only."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上玄天真武無上將軍籙",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that martial-exorcistic power under Zhenwu is licensed as a specialized generalship, not as generic 'northern spirit' devotion. The 籙 constructs a chain of command: the recipient becomes a subordinate officer under the Supreme General, authorized to deploy specific troops against demonic disorder. Protection is thus military-administrative, contingent on loyalty, purity, and correct use of the general's seal and roster.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Chaos (邪) is framed as rebellious force requiring disciplined suppression. Inference 1: Zhenwu's office is commander-in-chief of a defined spirit army. Inference 2: The 籙 transfers a limited commission, not the generalship itself. Inference 3: Ritual acts (召將, 遣兵, 鎮煞) are orders issued under that commission. Inference 4: Misuse or impurity constitutes mutiny or desertion, voiding cover. Conclusion: Effective 武当/真武-style defense is delegated military authority under a transmitted register.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, when 七杀/偏官 or 羊刃 patterns need constructive channeling, use Zhenwu-register logic: bind 'killing qi' to lawful command and protective mission. 2) Before martial-exorcistic rites, reaffirm subordination and purity rules as preconditions of cover. 3) Map client's 'enemy' problems (lawsuit, bullying, nightmares) to orderly 遣兵 steps rather than vague prayer. 4) Schedule strong fire/water balancing work with awareness of Zhenwu's north/martial symbolism as regulation of excess, not aggression cult. 5) Keep the 籙's ethical limits explicit: no private revenge under sacred commission.",
      "logic_compare": "More specialized than general 正一盟威 multi-office registers; it is a single-commander martial portfolio. Differs from 延生保命籙, which prioritizes life-preservation and destiny-stabilization over combat hierarchy. Unlike popular Zhenwu hagiography, the 籙 is about commission and troops, not only mythic biography."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上正一延生保命籙",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that lifespan and destiny threats are addressable through a covenanted extension-and-protection warrant, not only through medicine or fatalism. 延生保命 is an administrative petition to rewrite or buffer life-accounts under Zhengyi authority. The 籙's logic is preventive and restorative: bind vital spirits, repel life-cutting agencies, and stabilize the person's allotted course.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Life years and 命 are bookkept in celestial ledgers and assailable by 凶煞/罪籍. Inference 1: Zhengyi 籙 can open a lawful channel to petition 延生 and 保命. Inference 2: Protection requires naming the person, fate factors, and threats within ritual form. Inference 3: Efficacy depends on moral rectification plus register warrant, not talisman paper alone. Inference 4: The goal is stabilization of the life trajectory, not unlimited immortality claim. Conclusion: Longevity work is ledger-and-warrant practice under 正一, intermediate between pure fate acceptance and alchemical transcendence.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, pair weak 日主, severe 空亡, or 疾厄 patterns with 保命-style remedial logic: stabilize roots before aggressive career/wealth activation. 2) Use annual/ monthly 太岁 and 关煞 periods as times for protective 籙 rites rather than only passive fear. 3) Combine medical care with ritual 'ledger petition' language when clients face health scares—without replacing medicine. 4) Practice daily 存神/binding of 三魂七魄 as micro-version of 保命. 5) Measure success as reduced volatility of life events, not miracle claims.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Zhenwu 將軍籙 (martial suppression), this prioritizes conservation of life-force and destiny continuity. Differs from 内丹 immortality programs by remaining liturgical-covenantal and person-specific. Compared with generic 'blessing' texts, it is register-based and ledger-aware rather than pure emotional petition."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "正一法文法籙部儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that 法 and 籙 form a departmental system: methods are organized by bureau, each with procedures, personnel, and documents. Ritual correctness is therefore archival and bureaucratic—matching the right 部, the right 文, and the right sequence—rather than improvisational spirituality. The priest acts as clerk-officer of a multi-department celestial government.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Heaven's governance is divided into bureaus (部) with distinct dossiers. Inference 1: Human 法籙 must mirror those bureaus to interface correctly. Inference 2: 部儀 standardizes how documents are issued, filed, and activated. Inference 3: Cross-department confusion (wrong 籙 for wrong case) nullifies or misroutes the petition. Inference 4: Mastery means knowing the map of departments, not collecting random spells. Conclusion: Zhengyi practice is systematic administrative theology enacted through 法籙 departments.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Classify client problems into 'departments' (health, justice, weather, ancestors, demons) before choosing method—BaZi as diagnostic filing system. 2) Build personal protocol checklists per 部 (what papers, what offerings, what day stems). 3) Train students by bureau rotation rather than random technique dumps. 4) When a method fails, re-file: reassess which celestial office should hear the case. 5) Keep a living index of 籙 contents analogous to a departmental handbook.",
      "logic_compare": "More organizational than single-focus 籙 (真武/延生). Differs from 十籙召儀 by emphasizing archival structure of 法籙 as a whole, not only summoning ranks. Unlike 参同契-style internal alchemy, it externalizes order as bureaucracy rather than as microcosmic cosmology alone."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "正一法文太上外籙儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that entry into the Zhengyi system is staged: 外籙 (outer registers) create a legitimate but limited membership before inner or higher warrants. Outer investiture is not fake religion; it is the lawful perimeter of practice for beginners and lay affiliates. The logic prevents both exclusion (no path in) and premature empowerment (full power without formation).",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Spiritual authority must be graduated to protect person and community. Inference 1: 外籙 grants recognition, basic protections, and restricted rites. Inference 2: Ritual of 外籙 establishes identity and obligation without full 都功/inner portfolios. Inference 3: Progression to higher 籙 is earned by demonstrated fidelity under outer constraints. Inference 4: Claiming inner powers while holding only outer status is fraudulent. Conclusion: Outer register is a real legal threshold, not a decorative starter badge.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Design cultivation tiers: outer ethics + basic 斋戒 + limited petitions before advanced 召将. 2) In BaZi mentoring, match remedial complexity to the client's 'outer vs inner' maturity. 3) Explicitly state what outer practitioners may and may not do. 4) Use 外籙 logic for community members who support temples without full ordination. 5) Review readiness for upgrade by duty-keeping record, not by eagerness alone.",
      "logic_compare": "Narrower and more introductory than 醮…立成儀 full constitution. Contrasts with 傳都功版儀, which concerns apex office, not entry. Differs from popular instant-empowerment talisman sales by insisting on graded perimeter membership."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "受籙次第法信儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that receiving 籙 is an ordered economy of trust: sequence (次第) and ritual pledges/offerings (法信) are co-conditions of valid transmission. Skipping order or omitting 法信 breaks the reciprocal bond between transmitter, recipient, and Heaven. Validity is therefore procedural and material, not only intentional.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: 籙 are ranked and each rank presupposes prior ranks and proofs of sincerity. Inference 1: 次第 encodes pedagogical and ontological prerequisites. Inference 2: 法信 (texts, goods, oaths, fees of faith) objectify commitment and compensate the transmitting office. Inference 3: Disorderly receiving creates illegal hybrids of power without formation. Inference 4: Both teacher and student are bound by the same procedural law. Conclusion: Legitimate 受籙 is sequenced covenant exchange, not shopping for powers.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Never stack advanced BaZi/ritual techniques before foundational calendar, ethics, and basic 斋. 2) Make '法信' concrete: time investment, written vows, supervised practice hours—not only money. 3) Document the order of what was received and when. 4) Refuse to teach out of sequence even if the student pays more. 5) When problems arise post-transmission, check whether 次第 or 法信 was defective.",
      "logic_compare": "Complements 外籙儀 and 傳都功 by specifying the procedural grammar connecting all ranks. More explicit about reciprocal material-symbolic pledges than purely doctrinal 三洞 texts. Unlike free online 'empowerments,' it treats transmission as accountable exchange under Heaven's audit."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "正一法文經護國醮海品",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that Zhengyi ritual scale extends from person to polity and even maritime domain: the same covenantal logic that protects a household can be scaled to 護國 and 醮海. State and sea are not outside Daoist jurisdiction; they are larger 'bodies' requiring appropriately scaled 醮. Collective security is thus a liturgical-political application of 正一盟威, not a separate secular category.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Disorder at national or oceanic scale is still cosmic-administrative disorder. Inference 1: 醮 can be composed for 国 as for family, with expanded offerings and offices. Inference 2: 海 as domain has spirit governance addressable by proper 品. Inference 3: Priestly duty includes public-good rites when authorized. Inference 4: Success criteria are peace, harvest, calm waters, and political stability as signs of restored accord. Conclusion: Zhengyi liturgy is scalable public theology for land and sea polities.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Scale BaZi thinking from individual chart to family/enterprise/state 'weather' of qi without losing hierarchical warrant. 2) For community crises (epidemic, flood, conflict), design collective 醮 logic: shared confession, shared petition, shared merit. 3) Treat environmental/maritime anxiety with ritual ecology: respect domain spirits as stakeholders. 4) Distinguish private revenge rites from 護國-level public protection. 5) Train in liturgical composition: same grammar, larger assembly and longer sequences.",
      "logic_compare": "Moves beyond person-centered 延生保命 to macro-jurisdiction. Differs from purely imperial Confucian state sacrifice by remaining within 正一盟威 register theology. Unlike internal alchemy texts, efficacy is public, seasonal, and geopolitical rather than solitary transformation."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契发挥",
      "logic_thesis": "Yu Yan's elaboration proves that the Cantongqi's obscurities become operable when Yijing cosmology, alchemy, and calendrics are systematically 'played out' (发挥) into a unified interpretive machine. The text argues that 参同 is not mystical fog but a multi-domain isomorphism: hexagrams, lunar phases, and elixir work share one logic if correctly mapped. Elaboration is therefore the proof procedure that converts classic riddles into teachable structure.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: 参同契 compresses Zhouyi, Huang-Lao, and furnace work into dense symbols. Inference 1: Without 发挥, readers freeze at metaphor and project fantasies. Inference 2: Systematic expansion shows one law recurring across scale (heaven-time-body-drug). Inference 3: Where mappings cohere across domains, interpretation is confirmed; where they break, reading is false. Inference 4: The goal is operable theory for cultivation timing and method selection. Conclusion: True understanding of Cantongqi is demonstrated by coherent multi-domain elaboration, not citation of isolated lines.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Practice BaZi as one scale of the same 阴阳消息 logic used in 参同 lunar-hexagram timing. 2) When a classic line is obscure, force a three-domain map: calendar / body / ethical conduct. 3) Use 发挥 method: write the mapping table, then test against lived cycles (month, hour, breath). 4) Reject one-domain fundamentalism (only chemistry or only pure metaphor). 5) Teach students to expand one image (e.g., 坎离) across chart, meditation, and daily schedule.",
      "logic_compare": "More synthetic and expansive than terse 注 that gloss line-by-line. Differs from 考异, which hunts textual variants rather than operational unity. Compared with 悟真直指, it remains anchored in Cantongqi's Zhouyi-alchemy frame rather than later Southern Lineage three-vehicle pedagogy alone."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契解",
      "logic_thesis": "An '解' of the Cantongqi proves that the classic's authority depends on sense-making paraphrase: the text must be unfolded into plain causal claims about how yin-yang waxing produces elixir. The argument is that difficulty is pedagogical encryption, and 解 is decryption into propositions one can affirm or deny. Without such resolution into meanings, recitation is empty orthodoxy.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Sacred density can hide or reveal depending on interpretive labor. Inference 1: 解 prioritizes semantic clarity over philological apparatus alone. Inference 2: Each image is converted into a claim about process (when to advance fire, when to withdraw). Inference 3: Internal consistency of the prose solution tests the reading. Inference 4: Students inherit a usable doctrine, not only a sealed scripture. Conclusion: Cantongqi becomes doctrine through explanatory resolution of its symbols into process logic.",
      "logic_practice": "1) After reading any dense BaZi/Daoist line, write a one-sentence causal claim ('if X phase, then Y action'). 2) Build a glossary that converts alchemical metaphors into timing and breath rules. 3) Check whether your 解 predicts real cycle turns in charts and practice. 4) Prefer reversible explanations (can be re-encrypted into the image) over free associations. 5) Use paired study: one person quotes, one person must 解 without jargon.",
      "logic_compare": "Less variant-critical than 考异, less doubt-focused than 释疑, more meaning-first than bare 注. Differs from 发挥 by aiming at clear solutions of passages rather than maximal multi-domain expansion. Compared with 龙虎经注疏, it stays within Cantongqi's specific Zhouyi-elixir fusion."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契注",
      "logic_thesis": "Line-by-line 注 proves that the Cantongqi must be anchored phrase-by-phrase to prevent drift into free mysticism. The core argument is that authority flows from continuous contact with the wording: each clause is a constraint on practice. Annotation is a discipline of fidelity—practice may innovate only within what the lines can bear.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Dense classics are vulnerable to projection. Inference 1: 注 ties interpretation to discrete textual units. Inference 2: Local glosses accumulate into a global reading. Inference 3: Contradictions between glosses force revision of practice claims. Inference 4: The annotated classic becomes a regulated standard for schools. Conclusion: Reliable Cantongqi tradition is text-constrained commentary, not unmoored inspiration.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi study of classics (e.g., 滴天髓), adopt 注 discipline: claim only what a sentence supports. 2) Keep a facing-page practice: original line | permitted inference | forbidden overread. 3) When two teachers disagree, return to the lemma (the exact phrase). 4) Train juniors to annotate before they 'create methods.' 5) Use commentary conflicts as signals to suspend action until textual ground is clear.",
      "logic_compare": "More atomistic than 发挥 or 解. Unlike 考异, it assumes a base text and explains rather than adjudicates editions. Multiple historical 注 traditions share this fidelity logic while differing in school emphasis (internal vs dual cultivation vs cosmological)."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契考异",
      "logic_thesis": "Zhu Xi's 考异 proves that before metaphysical commitment, one must establish what the text actually is: variants change doctrines. The argument is that philological difference is not pedantry but the gate of truth—wrong wording yields wrong fire phases and wrong cosmology. Critical comparison of witnesses is therefore spiritual hygiene.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Transmission multiplies copies and errors. Inference 1: Doctrinal disputes may be artifacts of bad readings. Inference 2: 考异 collates variants and judges likelihood. Inference 3: A stabilized text enables fair commentary and practice. Inference 4: Intellectual honesty about uncertainty is part of Daoist rigor. Conclusion: Textual criticism is a necessary first alchemy on the book itself.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When using any BaZi formula from late manuals, check earlier sources and note variants. 2) Mark confidence levels: attested early / later accretion / folk overlay. 3) Do not build irreversible cultivation regimes on contested lines. 4) Teach students a mini-考异 habit: compare two editions before memorizing. 5) Separate 'beautiful interpretation' from 'textually warranted interpretation.'",
      "logic_compare": "Prior to and distinct from 注/解/发挥: it adjudicates the substrate those genres explain. Differs from 释疑, which clears conceptual puzzles more than manuscript puzzles. Compared with devotional recensions, it accepts Confucian-critical method as compatible with Daoist classic study."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契注",
      "logic_thesis": "A second major 注 tradition proves that the same Cantongqi wording can be constrained toward a school-specific operational physics (e.g., internal clockwork of 坎离、子午、火候) while still claiming textual fidelity. The argument is not that the text is vague, but that annotation selects the lawful axis of application—body-time over external furnace or vice versa. Commentary thus both limits and orients.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: One classic feeds multiple lineages. Inference 1: 注 encodes a school's decision about primary referent (body, couple, laboratory, polity). Inference 2: Consistency within that referent is the school's proof of reading. Inference 3: Cross-school conflict often reflects axis choice, not mere error. Inference 4: Practitioners must declare their axis to avoid mixed protocols. Conclusion: Annotation is a commitment to an operational frame under textual constraint.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Declare your frame when applying 参同 to BaZi: chart-as-heavens vs body-as-furnace vs both with explicit bridges. 2) Avoid mixing dual-cultivation instructions with pure 清修 clocks without a conversion rule. 3) Extract 火候 as schedule: when to advance, hold, retreat in practice days. 4) Use the school's 注 as a safety rail against internet eclecticism. 5) Periodically re-read base lines without your school's gloss to see the constraint surface again.",
      "logic_compare": "Shares lemma-fidelity with other 注 but differs by stronger operational monism of one school axis. Unlike 考异, it does not primarily settle wording. Unlike 悟真直指, it still speaks in Cantongqi's archaic Zhouyi-elixir idiom rather than Song Southern Lineage vehicle schema."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契注",
      "logic_thesis": "A further 注 layer proves that cosmological decoding (hexagrams as seasonal and diurnal governors) is sufficient to regulate human timing without requiring laboratory apparatus. The argument converts 参同 into a philosophy of right-time action: elixir is what happens when action matches cosmic phase. Thus annotation moralizes and temporalizes practice.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Zhouyi structures time as qualitative phases, not empty chronology. Inference 1: Cantongqi binds elixir stages to those phases. Inference 2: 注 spells out which phase forbids forcing and which demands work. Inference 3: Personal schedules should nest inside celestial schedules. Inference 4: Failure often means phase-violation, not lack of secret substance. Conclusion: Annotated Cantongqi yields a ethics of timing as the core of cultivation success.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Align BaZi day/hour pillars with practice 火候: use supportive hours for 进阳火, weak hours for 沐浴/rest. 2) Read annual luck not only as fortune but as permitted intensity of work. 3) Install calendar gates in training plans (lunar quarters, solar terms). 4) When stuck, ask 'wrong phase?' before 'wrong technique?' 5) Teach clients timing of decisions as micro-elixir skill.",
      "logic_compare": "More calendrical-ethical than laboratory-chemical readings; more outer-time than pure 黄庭 visceral maps. Differs from 释疑 by asserting a positive timing system rather than mainly clearing objections. Contrasts with 籙儀 texts: authority here is cosmic phase, not transmitted office warrant."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契注",
      "logic_thesis": "Yet another 注 trajectory proves that linguistic alchemy—names, images, and numbers—must be reduced to yin-yang functions or else practice idolizes metaphors. The argument is demythologizing in a Daoist key: dragons, tigers, and chariots are operators in a binary-and-five process algebra. Correct 注 is functional reduction without loss of rigor.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Mythic vocabulary encodes process variables. Inference 1: 注 maps each mythic noun to a function (lead/mercury, water/fire, movement/stillness). Inference 2: Equations of function replace story-logic. Inference 3: Practice becomes adjustable parameters, not propitiation of story beings. Inference 4: Over-literal myth produces category errors in training. Conclusion: Annotation fulfills the classic by translating myth into operable dual-process logic.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Build a two-column dictionary: image → function for every 参同 animal/metal metaphor. 2) In BaZi, similarly reduce gods of 十神 to functions (output, control, resource) before storytelling. 3) Design practice tweaks as parameter changes (more stillness, less forced fire). 4) Ban untranslated mythic speech in supervision meetings. 5) Re-poetize only after functional control is stable—so poetry does not re-occlude method.",
      "logic_compare": "More reductionist than hagiographic or purely literary 注. Differs from 龙虎经注疏 by applying functional reduction inside Cantongqi's Zhouyi frame specifically. Contrasts with 法籙部儀 where 'names' are real offices; here names are algebraic masks unless one is in liturgical mode."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易参同契释疑",
      "logic_thesis": "释疑 proves that the Cantongqi tradition advances by targeted removal of blockers: contradictions, paradoxical images, and rival readings that paralyze practice. The core argument is that doubt is not impiety but a clinical symptom of incomplete mapping, and systematic Q&A is the cure. Clearing doubt restores actionable conviction without requiring new revelation.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Dense classics generate predictable aporias. Inference 1: Unresolved doubt freezes 火候 decisions. Inference 2: 释疑 isolates each puzzle and dissolves it with distinctions (layers, stages, metaphors vs operations). Inference 3: After dissolution, practice can resume under clearer rules. Inference 4: Residual mystery is narrowed to what must remain non-propositional. Conclusion: Progress depends on disciplined doubt-resolution as much as on secret transmission.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Keep a 'doubt log' in BaZi/cultivation study; do not pretend certainty. 2) For each doubt, force a distinction: textual / practical / ethical. 3) Use Socratic pairs: state the paradox, then the missing middle term. 4) Only after 释疑, lock a protocol for 21–49 days to test. 5) Teach juniors that asking precise doubts is higher skill than quoting answers.",
      "logic_compare": "Genre differs from 注 (continuous gloss) and 考异 (variants): it is problem-driven. Unlike 发挥, it may not build a total system, only unblock nodes. Compared with faith-only piety, it treats intellect as a legitimate alchemical tool for removing obstruction."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "紫阳真人悟真直指详说三乘秘要",
      "logic_thesis": "This detailed pointing to Wuzhen's three vehicles proves that awakening has a graded vehicle logic: lower, middle, and higher '乘' are different capacity-matched strategies, not contradictory truths. The argument is pedagogical realism—one ultimate aim, multiple lawful curricula—against both flat egalitarianism and cryptic one-size secrecy. 直指 means the essentials are speakable with precision once vehicle is correctly assigned.",
      "logic_chain": "Premise: Beings differ in roots, and 悟真 encodes multiple tracks. Inference 1: Misassigning vehicle wastes life (too advanced or too coarse). Inference 2: 详说 makes secret essentials explicit per vehicle. Inference 3: Higher vehicles presuppose lower stabilizations. thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from 20 classical Chinese Daoist/BaZi related texts and return a structured JSON response. However, I need to clarify something important: the specific texts you listed (like 正一法文十籙召儀, 周易参同契, etc.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that celestial authority is not abstract belief but operational jurisdiction: only graded 籙 (registers) authorize a priest to summon specific spirit cohorts. Summoning efficacy is therefore a function of transmitted rank plus correct ritual form, not of personal charisma or ad-hoc prayer. Hierarchy of 籙 encodes a map of which powers may be called, under what warrant, and with what liability if misused.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Heaven's bureaucracy is ordered by ranks and warrants, mirrored in transmitted 籙. Inference 1: A name or deity may be invoked only if the officiant's 籙 lists the corresponding spirit office. Inference 2: The ten-register system partitions summoning rights so lower ranks cannot usurp higher commands. Inference 3: Ritual protocol (召儀) is the legal procedure that activates the warrant, not optional theater. Inference 4: Failed summons or spiritual backlash is evidence of rank-protocol mismatch, not mere 'lack of faith.' Conclusion: Legitimate spirit work is licensed administrative action within a transmitted hierarchy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi/ritual counseling, treat 'which spirits/forces one may petition' as rank-dependent: map client's or practitioner's training level to permitted scopes of 召. 2) Before any exorcistic or petitionary work, verify transmission chain and 籙 grade the way one verifies professional license. 3) Design cultivation stages so each stage unlocks a defined jurisdiction (protective, healing, weather, ancestral), never all at once. 4) Diagnose ritual failure first as warrant mismatch (wrong 籙, wrong day, wrong office), then as technical error. 5) Keep a written inventory of 'authorized actions' analogous to the ten-register roster.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike generic prayer manuals that assume any sincere heart can call any deity, this text insists on jurisdictional warrant. It differs from purely meditative 内丹 texts by treating efficacy as external bureaucratic legitimacy, not only internal qi refinement. Compared with later popular 符法 compilations, it foregrounds graded 籙 as the legal root of 召 rather than the talisman alone as a free-floating tool.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that institutional continuity of Zhengyi authority rests on a single transferable office-token—the 都功版—not on scattered personal sanctity. Transmission of that tablet is a legal investiture: the recipient becomes accountable steward of communal ritual power. Without formal 傳版, claimed leadership is administratively void even if ritually skilled.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Communal Daoist order requires a chief merit/office holder (都功) to coordinate rites and 籙. Inference 1: The 版 is the durable credential that outlasts individual charisma. Inference 2: 傳儀 specifies witnesses, oaths, and materials so succession is public and contestable, not private. Inference 3: Accepting the 版 creates duty (protect community, uphold 盟威, manage 籙), not merely privilege. Inference 4: Illegitimate holders lack the tablet chain and therefore lack standing to ordain or adjudicate. Conclusion: Legitimate Zhengyi headship is proven by continuous, ritualized transmission of the 都功版.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Model lineage succession in modern practice as documented transfer of role + responsibility, not Instagram endorsement. 2) When studying BaZi masters or ritual teachers, ask who invested them and with what token of office. 3) Separate 'skill demonstration' from 'office authority' when evaluating practitioners. 4) In personal cultivation, treat milestones (e.g., first full 籙, first independent jiao) as investitures that add duties. 5) Record transmission dates, witnesses, and scope of authority as a living legal file.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 受籙次第 texts that rank what individuals receive, this focuses on who may govern the system of receiving. It differs from purely hagiographic master-disciple stories by making a material tablet the proof of office. Compared with monastic abbacy models, 都功 is liturgical-legal stewardship of 正一 registers more than property or celibate rule.

entries.name_han: 醮三洞真文五法正一盟威籙立成儀
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that full Zhengyi covenant identity is completed only when Three Caverns true texts, Five Methods, and Mengwei registers are ritually established together in a 醮. Partial exposure to scriptures without 立成 (formal constitution of the 籙) does not create covenantal standing. Integration of canon strata with register investiture is the logical condition of being a '正一盟威' practitioner in the full sense.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Daoist revelation is stratified (三洞) and operationalized through 籙 and methods (五法). Inference 1: Reading 真文 without 立成 leaves the text informational, not binding. Inference 2: 盟威 covenant requires mutual obligation between Heaven and recipient, sealed in 醮. Inference 3: Combining 三洞 + 五法 + 正一籙 prevents sectarian fragmentation of authority. Inference 4: '立成' means the 籙 is constituted as a living warrant in time and place, not merely copied. Conclusion: Complete Zhengyi personhood is a multi-layer ritual constitution, not single-scripture conversion.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Structure training curricula as layered constitution: doctrine (三洞) → methods (五法) → warrants (籙) → public seal (醮). 2) Do not grant clients or students 'full path' claims after one book or one talisman course. 3) Use BaZi timing for 立成 moments (auspicious days for covenant, not only for fortune-telling). 4) Treat ethical vows in the 醮 as binding constraints on later magical practice. 5) Audit whether one's practice is only textual study, only technique, or fully covenanted.
entries.logic_compare: Broader than single-register manuals (e.g., 延生保命籙 alone), it synthesizes canon and covenant. Unlike pure liturgy of petition without ordination, it insists on 立成 of 籙 as identity formation. Relative to 外籙儀, it aims at fuller multi-stratum constitution rather than outer/introductory enrollment only.

entries.name_han: 太上玄天真武無上將軍籙
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that martial-exorcistic power under Zhenwu is licensed as a specialized generalship, not as generic 'northern spirit' devotion. The 籙 constructs a chain of command: the recipient becomes a subordinate officer under the Supreme General, authorized to deploy specific troops against demonic disorder. Protection is thus military-administrative, contingent on loyalty, purity, and correct use of the general's seal and roster.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Chaos (邪) is framed as rebellious force requiring disciplined suppression. Inference 1: Zhenwu's office is commander-in-chief of a defined spirit army. Inference 2: The 籙 transfers a limited commission, not the generalship itself. Inference 3: Ritual acts (召將, 遣兵, 鎮煞) are orders issued under that commission. Inference 4: Misuse or impurity constitutes mutiny or desertion, voiding cover. Conclusion: Effective 武当/真武-style defense is delegated military authority under a transmitted register.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, when 七杀/偏官 or 羊刃 patterns need constructive channeling, use Zhenwu-register logic: bind 'killing qi' to lawful command and protective mission. 2) Before martial-exorcistic rites, reaffirm subordination and purity rules as preconditions of cover. 3) Map client's 'enemy' problems (lawsuit, bullying, nightmares) to orderly 遣兵 steps rather than vague prayer. 4) Schedule strong fire/water balancing work with awareness of Zhenwu's north/martial symbolism as regulation of excess, not aggression cult. 5) Keep the 籙's ethical limits explicit: no private revenge under sacred commission.
entries.logic_compare: More specialized than general 正一盟威 multi-office registers; it is a single-commander martial portfolio. Differs from 延生保命籙, which prioritizes life-preservation and destiny-stabilization over combat hierarchy. Unlike popular Zhenwu hagiography, the 籙 is about commission and troops, not only mythic biography.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that lifespan and destiny threats are addressable through a covenanted extension-and-protection warrant, not only through medicine or fatalism. 延生保命 is an administrative petition to rewrite or buffer life-accounts under Zhengyi authority. The 籙's logic is preventive and restorative: bind vital spirits, repel life-cutting agencies, and stabilize the person's allotted course.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Life years and 命 are bookkept in celestial ledgers and assailable by 凶煞/罪籍. Inference 1: Zhengyi 籙 can open a lawful channel to petition 延生 and 保命. Inference 2: Protection requires naming the person, fate factors, and threats within ritual form. Inference 3: Efficacy depends on moral rectification plus register warrant, not talisman paper alone. Inference 4: The goal is stabilization of the life trajectory, not unlimited immortality claim. Conclusion: Longevity work is ledger-and-warrant practice under 正一, intermediate between pure fate acceptance and alchemical transcendence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, pair weak 日主, severe 空亡, or 疾厄 patterns with 保命-style remedial logic: stabilize roots before aggressive career/wealth activation. 2) Use annual/ monthly 太岁 and 关煞 periods as times for protective 籙 rites rather than only passive fear. 3) Combine medical care with ritual 'ledger petition' language when clients face health scares—without replacing medicine. 4) Practice daily 存神/binding of 三魂七魄 as micro-version of 保命. 5) Measure success as reduced volatility of life events, not miracle claims.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Zhenwu 將軍籙 (martial suppression), this prioritizes conservation of life-force and destiny continuity. Differs from 内丹 immortality programs by remaining liturgical-covenantal and person-specific. Compared with generic 'blessing' texts, it is register-based and ledger-aware rather than pure emotional petition.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that 法 and 籙 form a departmental system: methods are organized by bureau, each with procedures, personnel, and documents. Ritual correctness is therefore archival and bureaucratic—matching the right 部, the right 文, and the right sequence—rather than improvisational spirituality. The priest acts as clerk-officer of a multi-department celestial government.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Heaven's governance is divided into bureaus (部) with distinct dossiers. Inference 1: Human 法籙 must mirror those bureaus to interface correctly. Inference 2: 部儀 standardizes how documents are issued, filed, and activated. Inference 3: Cross-department confusion (wrong 籙 for wrong case) nullifies or misroutes the petition. Inference 4: Mastery means knowing the map of departments, not collecting random spells. Conclusion: Zhengyi practice is systematic administrative theology enacted through 法籙 departments.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Classify client problems into 'departments' (health, justice, weather, ancestors, demons) before choosing method—BaZi as diagnostic filing system. 2) Build personal protocol checklists per 部 (what papers, what offerings, what day stems). 3) Train students by bureau rotation rather than random technique dumps. 4) When a method fails, re-file: reassess which celestial office should hear the case. 5) Keep a living index of 籙 contents analogous to a departmental handbook.
entries.logic_compare: More organizational than single-focus 籙 (真武/延生). Differs from 十籙召儀 by emphasizing archival structure of 法籙 as a whole, not only summoning ranks. Unlike 参同契-style internal alchemy, it externalizes order as bureaucracy rather than as microcosmic cosmology alone.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that entry into the Zhengyi system is staged: 外籙 (outer registers) create a legitimate but limited membership before inner or higher warrants. Outer investiture is not fake religion; it is the lawful perimeter of practice for beginners and lay affiliates. The logic prevents both exclusion (no path in) and premature empowerment (full power without formation).
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Spiritual authority must be graduated to protect person and community. Inference 1: 外籙 grants recognition, basic protections, and restricted rites. Inference 2: Ritual of 外籙 establishes identity and obligation without full 都功/inner portfolios. Inference 3: Progression to higher 籙 is earned by demonstrated fidelity under outer constraints. Inference 4: Claiming inner powers while holding only outer status is fraudulent. Conclusion: Outer register is a real legal threshold, not a decorative starter badge.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Design cultivation tiers: outer ethics + basic 斋戒 + limited petitions before advanced 召将. 2) In BaZi mentoring, match remedial complexity to the client's 'outer vs inner' maturity. 3) Explicitly state what outer practitioners may and may not do. 4) Use 外籙 logic for community members who support temples without full ordination. 5) Review readiness for upgrade by duty-keeping record, not by eagerness alone.
entries.logic_compare: Narrower and more introductory than 醮…立成儀 full constitution. Contrasts with 傳都功版儀, which concerns apex office, not entry. Differs from popular instant-empowerment talisman sales by insisting on graded perimeter membership.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that receiving 籙 is an ordered economy of trust: sequence (次第) and ritual pledges/offerings (法信) are co-conditions of valid transmission. Skipping order or omitting 法信 breaks the reciprocal bond between transmitter, recipient, and Heaven. Validity is therefore procedural and material, not only intentional.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: 籙 are ranked and each rank presupposes prior ranks and proofs of sincerity. Inference 1: 次第 encodes pedagogical and ontological prerequisites. Inference 2: 法信 (texts, goods, oaths, fees of faith) objectify commitment and compensate the transmitting office. Inference 3: Disorderly receiving creates illegal hybrids of power without formation. Inference 4: Both teacher and student are bound by the same procedural law. Conclusion: Legitimate 受籙 is sequenced covenant exchange, not shopping for powers.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Never stack advanced BaZi/ritual techniques before foundational calendar, ethics, and basic 斋. 2) Make '法信' concrete: time investment, written vows, supervised practice hours—not only money. 3) Document the order of what was received and when. 4) Refuse to teach out of sequence even if the student pays more. 5) When problems arise post-transmission, check whether 次第 or 法信 was defective.
entries.logic_compare: Complements 外籙儀 and 傳都功 by specifying the procedural grammar connecting all ranks. More explicit about reciprocal material-symbolic pledges than purely doctrinal 三洞 texts. Unlike free online 'empowerments,' it treats transmission as accountable exchange under Heaven's audit.

entries.name_han: 正一法文經護國醮海品
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that Zhengyi ritual scale extends from person to polity and even maritime domain: the same covenantal logic that protects a household can be scaled to 護國 and 醮海. State and sea are not outside Daoist jurisdiction; they are larger 'bodies' requiring appropriately scaled 醮. Collective security is thus a liturgical-political application of 正一盟威, not a separate secular category.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Disorder at national or oceanic scale is still cosmic-administrative disorder. Inference 1: 醮 can be composed for 国 as for family, with expanded offerings and offices. Inference 2: 海 as domain has spirit governance addressable by proper 品. Inference 3: Priestly duty includes public-good rites when authorized. Inference 4: Success criteria are peace, harvest, calm waters, and political stability as signs of restored accord. Conclusion: Zhengyi liturgy is scalable public theology for land and sea polities.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Scale BaZi thinking from individual chart to family/enterprise/state 'weather' of qi without losing hierarchical warrant. 2) For community crises (epidemic, flood, conflict), design collective 醮 logic: shared confession, shared petition, shared merit. 3) Treat environmental/maritime anxiety with ritual ecology: respect domain spirits as stakeholders. 4) Distinguish private revenge rites from 護國-level public protection. 5) Train in liturgical composition: same grammar, larger assembly and longer sequences.
entries.logic_compare: Moves beyond person-centered 延生保命 to macro-jurisdiction. Differs from purely imperial Confucian state sacrifice by remaining within 正一盟威 register theology. Unlike internal alchemy texts, efficacy is public, seasonal, and geopolitical rather than solitary transformation.

entries.logic_thesis: Yu Yan's elaboration proves that the Cantongqi's obscurities become operable when Yijing cosmology, alchemy, and calendrics are systematically 'played out' (发挥) into a unified interpretive machine. The text argues that 参同 is not mystical fog but a multi-domain isomorphism: hexagrams, lunar phases, and elixir work share one logic if correctly mapped. Elaboration is therefore the proof procedure that converts classic riddles into teachable structure.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: 参同契 compresses Zhouyi, Huang-Lao, and furnace work into dense symbols. Inference 1: Without 发挥, readers freeze at metaphor and project fantasies. Inference 2: Systematic expansion shows one law recurring across scale (heaven-time-body-drug). Inference 3: Where mappings cohere across domains, interpretation is confirmed; where they break, reading is false. Inference 4: The goal is operable theory for cultivation timing and method selection. Conclusion: True understanding of Cantongqi is demonstrated by coherent multi-domain elaboration, not citation of isolated lines.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Practice BaZi as one scale of the same 阴阳消息 logic used in 参同 lunar-hexagram timing. 2) When a classic line is obscure, force a three-domain map: calendar / body / ethical conduct. 3) Use 发挥 method: write the mapping table, then test against lived cycles (month, hour, breath). 4) Reject one-domain fundamentalism (only chemistry or only pure metaphor). 5) Teach students to expand one image (e.g., 坎离) across chart, meditation, and daily schedule.
entries.logic_compare: More synthetic and expansive than terse 注 that gloss line-by-line. Differs from 考异, which hunts textual variants rather than operational unity. Compared with 悟真直指, it remains anchored in Cantongqi's Zhouyi-alchemy frame rather than later Southern Lineage three-vehicle pedagogy alone.

entries.logic_thesis: An '解' of the Cantongqi proves that the classic's authority depends on sense-making paraphrase: the text must be unfolded into plain causal claims about how yin-yang waxing produces elixir. The argument is that difficulty is pedagogical encryption, and 解 is decryption into propositions one can affirm or deny. Without such resolution into meanings, recitation is empty orthodoxy.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Sacred density can hide or reveal depending on interpretive labor. Inference 1: 解 prioritizes semantic clarity over philological apparatus alone. Inference 2: Each image is converted into a claim about process (when to advance fire, when to withdraw). Inference 3: Internal consistency of the prose solution tests the reading. Inference 4: Students inherit a usable doctrine, not only a sealed scripture. Conclusion: Cantongqi becomes doctrine through explanatory resolution of its symbols into process logic.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After reading any dense BaZi/Daoist line, write a one-sentence causal claim ('if X phase, then Y action'). 2) Build a glossary that converts alchemical metaphors into timing and breath rules. 3) Check whether your 解 predicts real cycle turns in charts and practice. 4) Prefer reversible explanations (can be re-encrypted into the image) over free associations. 5) Use paired study: one person quotes, one person must 解 without jargon.
entries.logic_compare: Less variant-critical than 考异, less doubt-focused than 释疑, more meaning-first than bare 注. Differs from 发挥 by aiming at clear solutions of passages rather than maximal multi-domain expansion. Compared with 龙虎经注疏, it stays within Cantongqi's specific Zhouyi-elixir fusion.

entries.logic_thesis: Line-by-line 注 proves that the Cantongqi must be anchored phrase-by-phrase to prevent drift into free mysticism. The core argument is that authority flows from continuous contact with the wording: each clause is a constraint on practice. Annotation is a discipline of fidelity—practice may innovate only within what the lines can bear.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Dense classics are vulnerable to projection. Inference 1: 注 ties interpretation to discrete textual units. Inference 2: Local glosses accumulate into a global reading. Inference 3: Contradictions between glosses force revision of practice claims. Inference 4: The annotated classic becomes a regulated standard for schools. Conclusion: Reliable Cantongqi tradition is text-constrained commentary, not unmoored inspiration.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi study of classics (e.g., 滴天髓), adopt 注 discipline: claim only what a sentence supports. 2) Keep a facing-page practice: original line | permitted inference | forbidden overread. 3) When two teachers disagree, return to the lemma (the exact phrase). 4) Train juniors to annotate before they 'create methods.' 5) Use commentary conflicts as signals to suspend action until textual ground is clear.
entries.logic_compare: More atomistic than 发挥 or 解. Unlike 考异, it assumes a base text and explains rather than adjudicates editions. Multiple historical 注 traditions share this fidelity logic while differing in school emphasis (internal vs dual cultivation vs cosmological).

entries.logic_thesis: Zhu Xi's 考异 proves that before metaphysical commitment, one must establish what the text actually is: variants change doctrines. The argument is that philological difference is not pedantry but the gate of truth—wrong wording yields wrong fire phases and wrong cosmology. Critical comparison of witnesses is therefore spiritual hygiene.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Transmission multiplies copies and errors. Inference 1: Doctrinal disputes may be artifacts of bad readings. Inference 2: 考异 collates variants and judges likelihood. Inference 3: A stabilized text enables fair commentary and practice. Inference 4: Intellectual honesty about uncertainty is part of Daoist rigor. Conclusion: Textual criticism is a necessary first alchemy on the book itself.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When using any BaZi formula from late manuals, check earlier sources and note variants. 2) Mark confidence levels: attested early / later accretion / folk overlay. 3) Do not build irreversible cultivation regimes on contested lines. 4) Teach students a mini-考异 habit: compare two editions before memorizing. 5) Separate 'beautiful interpretation' from 'textually warranted interpretation.'
entries.logic_compare: Prior to and distinct from 注/解/发挥: it adjudicates the substrate those genres explain. Differs from 释疑, which clears conceptual puzzles more than manuscript puzzles. Compared with devotional recensions, it accepts Confucian-critical method as compatible with Daoist classic study.

entries.logic_thesis: A second major 注 tradition proves that the same Cantongqi wording can be constrained toward a school-specific operational physics (e.g., internal clockwork of 坎离、子午、火候) while still claiming textual fidelity. The argument is not that the text is vague, but that annotation selects the lawful axis of application—body-time over external furnace or vice versa. Commentary thus both limits and orients.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: One classic feeds multiple lineages. Inference 1: 注 encodes a school's decision about primary referent (body, couple, laboratory, polity). Inference 2: Consistency within that referent is the school's proof of reading. Inference 3: Cross-school conflict often reflects axis choice, not mere error. Inference 4: Practitioners must declare their axis to avoid mixed protocols. Conclusion: Annotation is a commitment to an operational frame under textual constraint.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Declare your frame when applying 参同 to BaZi: chart-as-heavens vs body-as-furnace vs both with explicit bridges. 2) Avoid mixing dual-cultivation instructions with pure 清修 clocks without a conversion rule. 3) Extract 火候 as schedule: when to advance, hold, retreat in practice days. 4) Use the school's 注 as a safety rail against internet eclecticism. 5) Periodically re-read base lines without your school's gloss to see the constraint surface again.
entries.logic_compare: Shares lemma-fidelity with other 注 but differs by stronger operational monism of one school axis. Unlike 考异, it does not primarily settle wording. Unlike 悟真直指, it still speaks in Cantongqi's archaic Zhouyi-elixir idiom rather than Song Southern Lineage vehicle schema.

entries.logic_thesis: A further 注 layer proves that cosmological decoding (hexagrams as seasonal and diurnal governors) is sufficient to regulate human timing without requiring laboratory apparatus. The argument converts 参同 into a philosophy of right-time action: elixir is what happens when action matches cosmic phase. Thus annotation moralizes and temporalizes practice.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Zhouyi structures time as qualitative phases, not empty chronology. Inference 1: Cantongqi binds elixir stages to those phases. Inference 2: 注 spells out which phase forbids forcing and which demands work. Inference 3: Personal schedules should nest inside celestial schedules. Inference 4: Failure often means phase-violation, not lack of secret substance. Conclusion: Annotated Cantongqi yields a ethics of timing as the core of cultivation success.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Align BaZi day/hour pillars with practice 火候: use supportive hours for 进阳火, weak hours for 沐浴/rest. 2) Read annual luck not only as fortune but as permitted intensity of work. 3) Install calendar gates in training plans (lunar quarters, solar terms). 4) When stuck, ask 'wrong phase?' before 'wrong technique?' 5) Teach clients timing of decisions as micro-elixir skill.
entries.logic_compare: More calendrical-ethical than laboratory-chemical readings; more outer-time than pure 黄庭 visceral maps. Differs from 释疑 by asserting a positive timing system rather than mainly clearing objections. Contrasts with 籙儀 texts: authority here is cosmic phase, not transmitted office warrant.

entries.logic_thesis: Yet another 注 trajectory proves that linguistic alchemy—names, images, and numbers—must be reduced to yin-yang functions or else practice idolizes metaphors. The argument is demythologizing in a Daoist key: dragons, tigers, and chariots are operators in a binary-and-five process algebra. Correct 注 is functional reduction without loss of rigor.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Mythic vocabulary encodes process variables. Inference 1: 注 maps each mythic noun to a function (lead/mercury, water/fire, movement/stillness). Inference 2: Equations of function replace story-logic. Inference 3: Practice becomes adjustable parameters, not propitiation of story beings. Inference 4: Over-literal myth produces category errors in training. Conclusion: Annotation fulfills the classic by translating myth into operable dual-process logic.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build a two-column dictionary: image → function for every 参同 animal/metal metaphor. 2) In BaZi, similarly reduce gods of 十神 to functions (output, control, resource) before storytelling. 3) Design practice tweaks as parameter changes (more stillness, less forced fire). 4) Ban untranslated mythic speech in supervision meetings. 5) Re-poetize only after functional control is stable—so poetry does not re-occlude method.
entries.logic_compare: More reductionist than hagiographic or purely literary 注. Differs from 龙虎经注疏 by applying functional reduction inside Cantongqi's Zhouyi frame specifically. Contrasts with 法籙部儀 where 'names' are real offices; here names are algebraic masks unless one is in liturgical mode.

entries.logic_thesis: 释疑 proves that the Cantongqi tradition advances by targeted removal of blockers: contradictions, paradoxical images, and rival readings that paralyze practice. The core argument is that doubt is not impiety but a clinical symptom of incomplete mapping, and systematic Q&A is the cure. Clearing doubt restores actionable conviction without requiring new revelation.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Dense classics generate predictable aporias. Inference 1: Unresolved doubt freezes 火候 decisions. Inference 2: 释疑 isolates each puzzle and dissolves it with distinctions (layers, stages, metaphors vs operations). Inference 3: After dissolution, practice can resume under clearer rules. Inference 4: Residual mystery is narrowed to what must remain non-propositional. Conclusion: Progress depends on disciplined doubt-resolution as much as on secret transmission.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Keep a 'doubt log' in BaZi/cultivation study; do not pretend certainty. 2) For each doubt, force a distinction: textual / practical / ethical. 3) Use Socratic pairs: state the paradox, then the missing middle term. 4) Only after 释疑, lock a protocol for 21–49 days to test. 5) Teach juniors that asking precise doubts is higher skill than quoting answers.
entries.logic_compare: Genre differs from 注 (continuous gloss) and 考异 (variants): it is problem-driven. Unlike 发挥, it may not build a total system, only unblock nodes. Compared with faith-only piety, it treats intellect as a legitimate alchemical tool for removing obstruction.

entries.name_han: 紫阳真人悟真直指详说三乘秘要
entries.logic_thesis: This detailed pointing to Wuzhen's three vehicles proves that awakening has a graded vehicle logic: lower, middle, and higher '乘' are different capacity-matched strategies, not contradictory truths. The argument is pedagogical realism—one ultimate aim, multiple lawful curricula—against both flat egalitarianism and cryptic one-size secrecy. 直指 means the essentials are speakable with precision once vehicle is correctly assigned.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Beings differ in roots, and 悟真 encodes multiple tracks. Inference 1: Misassigning vehicle wastes life (too advanced or too coarse). Inference 2: 详说 makes secret essentials explicit per vehicle. Inference 3: Higher vehicles presuppose lower stabilizations. Inference 4: Verification signs differ by vehicle and must not be cross-judged. Conclusion: True pointing is stratified curriculum design under one Southern Lineage aim.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Diagnose student/client 'vehicle': ethics-calming, qi-canal work, or insight-integration—match methods. 2) In BaZi terms, read capacity (印/食伤/官杀 balance) as vehicle suitability, not moral rank alone. 3) Sequence 三乘: foundation → energy → spirit, with exams at each gate. 4) Forbid bragging that collapses vehicles into slogans. 5) Use 直指 speech: concrete checkpoints, not ornamental mystery.
entries.logic_compare: Later and more explicitly pedagogical than raw Cantongqi; translates alchemy into Song 内丹 vehicle schema. Differs from Zhengyi 籙次第 by ranking inner realization tracks rather than liturgical offices. Unlike single-path 注, it legitimates plural methods under one 悟真 compass.

entries.name_han: 黄庭内景五脏六腑补泻图
entries.logic_thesis: The text-and-chart system proves that inner cultivation is organ-specific medicine of qi: each zang-fu has excess/deficiency dynamics that demand 补 or 泻, not generic 'energy work.' Visualization and breath are therapeutically directed by visceral map, making the body a diagnosable landscape. The argument links 黄庭 imagery to actionable tonify/drain logic parallel to classical medicine.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Spirit and qi lodge in structured organs with seasonal and emotional correlates. Inference 1: Pathology is imbalance per organ, not only total qi lack. Inference 2: 图 externalizes the inner map so practice can target. Inference 3: 补泻 methods must match organ polarity and time. Inference 4: Wrong universal technique aggravates excess or starves deficiency. Conclusion: Precise visceral 补泻 is the rational core of 黄庭内景 practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Pair BaZi organ correspondences (e.g., weak Earth stems → spleen/stomach care) with 补泻 rather than only lucky colors. 2) Use charts to choose breath focus, visualization color, and emotional alchemy per organ. 3) Time organ work by seasons and 子午流注-style clocks. 4) Integrate medical diagnosis; do not 泻 a deficient organ. 5) Track symptoms as feedback for whether 补泻 direction was correct.
entries.logic_compare: More anatomically targeted than Cantongqi's cosmological 火候 algebra. Differs from 籙 summoning texts by turning authority inward to visceral spirits rather than external generals. Unlike pure 悟真 metaphysical vehicles, it is clinical-mapping and chart-driven.

entries.logic_thesis: The commentary-subcommentary on the ancient Dragon-Tiger Scripture proves that lead-tiger / mercury-dragon duals are the master binary of elixir work, and that 注疏 must keep this binary from collapsing into either pure chemistry or pure psychology. The argument is that 'ancient text' authority plus layered exegesis recovers a pre-Cantongqi (or parallel) grammar of union. Dragon-tiger mating is the invariant; schools only redescribe it.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: Elixir arises from regulated intercourse of two opposed yet complementary agents. Inference 1: Dragon/tiger name those agents across body and cosmos. Inference 2: 注 explains terms; 疏 expands implications and blocks misreadings. Inference 3: Timing and purity conditions govern when the two may meet. Inference 4: Forced meeting without basis produces illusory or dangerous 'elixirs.' Conclusion: Layered exegesis establishes dragon-tiger union as the stable logical core of external/internal alchemy continuity.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In practice, always identify your current 'dragon' and 'tiger' variables (e.g., 神/气, 水/火, 阴/阳 time). 2) Use BaZi as a readout of which agent is excessive before attempting union techniques. 3) Apply 注疏 method: define terms narrowly, then expand carefully. 4) Install safety: no aggressive dual work without established 根基. 5) Verify union by stable clarity and balanced chart behavior over weeks, not by sensational kriyas alone.
entries.logic_compare: Closer to metallurgical-alchemical diction than 黄庭's organ charts; more binary-focused than Cantongqi's multi-hexagram machinery, though often read alongside it. Differs from Zhengyi liturgical 籙 by seeking inner/operative union rather than celestial office warrant. Relative to 悟真三乘, it privileges one master dual over graded vehicles, making it a root grammar those vehicles still employ.
